standard.summary: 生成训练/LoRA 诊断分享卡。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Generates a shareable training/LoRA diagnostic card.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 生成训练/LoRA 诊断分享卡。可先用 Analyzer 得到指标，再填入这里。

advanced_en.principle: Generates a training/LoRA diagnostic share card. Run the Analyzer first to get metrics, then fill them in here.
